title.zh: 2日23:08UTC复检：无新分项死亡；中方43/519/2；尼方NDRRMA 1453/5285/13795
title.en: 2 Oct 23:08 UTC recheck: no new death split; CN 43/519/2; NP NDRRMA 1453/5285/13795
title.ne: 2 Oct 23:08 UTC: naya death split chaina; CN 43/519/2; NP NDRRMA 1453/5285/13795
title.hi: 2 Oct 23:08 UTC: naya death split nahi; CN 43/519/2; NP NDRRMA 1453/5285/13795

body.zh: 指挥部仍为9月5日18时：43死、519失联、2人获救。应急管理部9月17日合计562人死亡失踪，与分项一致。外交部9月24日仍只确认261名外籍失联。NDRRMA 10月2日SitRep 2280未列Bhotekoshi新伤亡。主KPI仍用NDRRMA 9月26日19:00报#25。堰塞湖已排空。口岸关闭。勿与中方相加。
body.en: Command centre remains 5 Sep 18:00: 43 dead, 519 missing, 2 rescued. MEM 17 Sep combined 562 dead/missing matches that split. MFA 24 Sep still only confirms 261 foreign missing. NDRRMA SitRep 2280 on 2 Oct lists no new Bhotekoshi casualties. Main KPI stays NDRRMA 26 Sep 19:00 report #25. Lake drained. Gate closed. Do not add CN.
body.ne: CN 5 Sep 18:00: 43/519/2. MEM 17 Sep 562 combined milcha. MFA 24 Sep: 261 foreign missing. SitRep 2280 ma Bhotekoshi naya casualty chaina. COP KPI NDRRMA #25 1453/5285/13795. Tal khali. Gate band. CN najodnu.
body.hi: CN 5 Sep 18:00: 43/519/2. MEM 17 Sep 562 combined milta hai. MFA 24 Sep: 261 videshi missing. SitRep 2280 mein Bhotekoshi naya casualty nahi. COP KPI NDRRMA #25 1453/5285/13795. Jheel khali. Gate band. CN na joden.

body.zh: 公布为全国灾害日报链接，未更新死亡/失联/获救，不替代#25。
body.en: National daily bulletin link only; no updated dead/missing/rescued. Does not replace report #25.
body.ne: Rashtriya daily bulletin matra. Naya split chaina; #25 badaldaina.
body.hi: Rashtriya daily bulletin matra. Naya split nahi; #25 nahi badalta.

title.zh: NDRRMA 10月1日：搜救结束，转入恢复并核查失联

title.hi: NDRRMA 1 Oct: SAR khatam; recovery aur missing satyapan

body.zh: 执行主任Upreti称已无生还可能，转搜寻遗体与核查失联。未公布新死亡/失联/获救分项，不替代#25。
body.en: Chief Upreti said no survivors expected; move to body recovery and missing verification. No new dead/missing/rescued split; does not replace report #25.
body.ne: Upreti: bacheko sambhav chaina. Naya split chaina; #25 badaldaina.
body.hi: Upreti: bache hone ki sambhavna nahi. Naya split nahi; #25 nahi badalta.

body.zh: 分县遗体统计已发；1334具已处置。未公布获救总数。安置1283人。COP主KPI仍用NDRRMA 1453/5285/13795。勿与中方相加。
body.en: District body counts posted; 1334 bodies managed. No rescued total. 1283 in shelters. COP main KPI remains NDRRMA 1453/5285/13795. Do not add CN.
body.ne: Jilla hisab; 1334 deha. Rescued total chaina. 1283 shelter. COP KPI NDRRMA. CN najodnu.
body.hi: Zila hisab; 1334 deh. Rescued total nahi. 1283 shelter. COP KPI NDRRMA. CN na joden.

title.zh: 9月30日报道：已找到1454具遗体，失联5285

body.zh: 仅识别112具。未给出新获救总数，不替代NDRRMA获救13795。DNA样本约3685份检测中。
body.en: Only 112 identified. No new rescued total; does not replace NDRRMA 13795 rescued. About 3685 DNA samples in testing.
body.ne: 112 chiniyo. Naya rescued chaina. DNA lagbhag 3685.
body.hi: 112 pehchane. Naya rescued nahi. DNA lagbhag 3685.

body.zh: 1453死、5285失联；21个安置点约1109人（Rasuwa 805）。25–28日强降雨专报未列Rasuwa新伤亡。
body.en: 1453 dead, 5285 missing; about 1109 in 21 centres (805 Rasuwa). 25-28 Sep rain report lists no new Rasuwa casualties.
body.ne: 1453/5285; 1109 shelter (Rasuwa 805). 25-28 barsa, Rasuwa naya casualty chaina.
body.hi: 1453/5285; 1109 shelter (Rasuwa 805). 25-28 barish, Rasuwa naya casualty nahi.
